summary: Replaces input image color values with values from a lookup table sampled from a second TOP or generated from CHOP values.

key_params.name: index
key_params.note: Index range components index1 and index2

key_params.name: channel
key_params.note: luminance, rgba channels, averages, maxima, or independent

key_params.name: independentalpha
key_params.note: Lookup alpha independently for scalar RGB modes

key_params.name: darkuv
key_params.note: Second-input UV coordinate for dark lookup endpoint

key_params.name: lightuv
key_params.note: Second-input UV coordinate for light lookup endpoint

key_params.name: chop
key_params.note: CHOP used as RGBA lookup table in chop method

key_params.name: clampchopvalues
key_params.note: Clamp CHOP lookup values between 0 and 1

key_params.name: displaylookup
key_params.note: Output the lookup table instead of applying it

common_gotchas: Indices outside index1/index2 hold the first or last lookup value rather than extrapolating.
The CHOP method ignores the second TOP input and uses the referenced CHOP instead.
independentalpha has no effect for RGBA Independent or Alpha channel modes.
Second-input lookup samples only the line between Dark UV and Light UV.
key_concepts: Uses the first input as an index image for color lookup replacement.
Lookup tables can come from a sampled line in the second TOP input or from CHOP RGBA values.
Index Range maps source values to lookup-table endpoints and holds out-of-range indices at the ends.
Index Channel selects scalar channel-derived lookup or independent RGBA lookup behavior.
Dark UV and Light UV define the sampled lookup line when using the second TOP input.
Output Lookup can emit the lookup table itself for diagnostics.
